intro: The easiest relocation for Russian citizens — no visa, the Russian language, and working international cards. Almaty and Astana are the IT centres.
climate: Sharply continental: cold winters and hot summers. Almaty is milder thanks to the mountains, Astana harsher.
mentality: A multi-ethnic country with a warm attitude towards Russians, especially in the cities. A well-developed Russian-language media environment.
language_note: Kazakh is the official language. Russian is the official language of inter-ethnic communication and is used everywhere in daily life.
visa_note: Visa-free for 90 days. Registration is done through eGov. A sole proprietorship can be set up in a day; residence permits are available via employment, business or family.
